phaseSemantics.prepare: Inherited directory/image collection. Construction loads polytone_options.json; pack/reload config overlays also have independent entrypoints.
phaseSemantics.parse: Both world-aware and worldless hooks clear/rebuild the option registry from builtins and enabled definitions, applying the retained config-file snapshot.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply and reset bodies are empty. UI edits call a separate disk writer and can request a later pack reload.
phaseSemantics.reset: Empty hook does not clear configs, the file snapshot, thread-local active registry, or reload-request flag.
phaseSemantics.live: Value lookup prefers a thread-local active registry, then the main registry; unknown keys warn and return numeric zero. Pack UI and main-menu UI are separate callers.

questions: Atomic text replacement is a delegated FilesUtil contract; no durability or multi-writer claim.
Follow UI edit/save/reload acknowledgement and cleanup of temporary config views.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode each noise configuration, build/register it, then regenerate expression noise functions.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty; registration and expression-function changes occur in parse.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear the noise registry; downstream function ownership remains a separate dependency.
phaseSemantics.live: Expression consumers call generated noise functions rather than the empty apply hook.

questions: Qualify partial registration if a later decode/build fails and lifetime of previously generated function references.

phaseSemantics.parse: Register enabled expressions and mutable value slots initialized to each declared default.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear expression/value maps and set lastGameTime to Long.MIN_VALUE.
phaseSemantics.live: tick reads level game time, suppresses a repeated time value, and evaluates entries on interval multiples; getValue returns zero for a missing slot.

questions: Game time is not a wall-clock deadline. Qualify level changes, expression context, off-thread readers, and retained Slot references.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Parse sound_events CSV into the manager field before returning default prepared assets.
phaseSemantics.parse: Construct missing sound events, dynamically register them, then decode/register enabled direct sound types. Existing IDs log and skip.
phaseSemantics.apply: Request SoundManager.reload when custom sound events exist; that request is not playback or reload completion.
phaseSemantics.reset: Unregister custom event IDs, then clear sound-event/type registries.
phaseSemantics.live: Block-set/property consumers reference sound types; actual sound files and playback remain separate.

questions: Qualify asynchronous sound reload and overlap between dynamic IDs, decoded types, sounds.json, and retained playback consumers.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode and register biome mappers; registration exceptions warn as duplicates, while decoder failures escape.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear mapper registry.
phaseSemantics.live: Colormap consumers resolve biome identity through the selected mapper.

questions: Do not treat every caught registration error as an independently proved duplicate. Mapper arithmetic and actual biome identity need their own contract.

phaseSemantics.parse: Add builtins, retry pending definitions while progress occurs, strict-decode leftovers, then create default colormaps for orphan textures.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear colormap registries and unregister custom platform color resolvers.
phaseSemantics.live: Color getters and biome/render consumers can retain references independently of the registry.

questions: Qualify reference cycles/ordering, image identity, concurrent getter instances, and active consumer invalidation.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Inherited resource collection. Early processing separately decodes model-only data and requests model registration.
phaseSemantics.parse: Decode factories, register/override providers, attach sprite sets, add GPU renderers, then resolve lazy emitter dependencies.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty; factory/provider effects already occur in parse.
phaseSemantics.reset: Unregister custom types/providers, move active GPU renderers to pending retirement, and restore overwritten vanilla providers.
phaseSemantics.live: CPU providers, emitter callbacks, GPU renderer list, and level-render-tail retirement are different consumers.

questions: retireAll is not close: pending renderers close in a later render call. No GPU-completion or full logout reclamation proof.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Inherited single-file stack collection and legacy conversion; not the default directory-only path.
phaseSemantics.parse: Parse color sections with direct mutation of vanilla presentation objects, manager fields, and other managers; per-file exceptions log and continue, then sheep colors regenerate.
phaseSemantics.apply: Call LevelRenderer.createStars; derived sheep colors regenerate in parse, not this hook.
phaseSemantics.reset: Restore captured map/dye/effect/text/egg/border values and explicit defaults; reset is field-specific rather than a generic rollback.
phaseSemantics.live: Map/environment/dye/particle/fishing/lightning/outline/painting/border/effect/egg/sheep/xporb/redstone/text/palette and entity-shadow paths have separate consumers.

questions: Section and per-entry failure can preserve earlier mutations. Complete field/default/restoration coverage and each renderer consumer remain open.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Optionally detect texture-derived light colors and replace textureLightColors before returning prepared assets.
phaseSemantics.parse: Resolve enabled typed block/entity/item/particle targets and add their light definitions.
phaseSemantics.apply: Add texture lights, flatten aliases, select configured backend storage, then install available light-source consumers.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear definitions/aliases, clear each source and storage, then detach source/storage references.
phaseSemantics.live: Backend storage, moving/block light sources, voxel aliases, and shader patches require separate renderer capability gates.

questions: Backend selection and non-null storage do not establish active shader ownership, device compatibility, or retirement of all consumers.

phaseSemantics.parse: Register vanilla block-set providers and decoded custom providers.
phaseSemantics.apply: Log the resulting registry size.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear block-set registry and reset generated-name counter.
phaseSemantics.live: Block-property consumers use these providers to build/apply sound-related block-set data.

questions: Qualify registry identity, generated names, duplicate policy, and captured references in modified blocks.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Merge legacy OptiFine/Colormatic inputs and own images; replace ofProperties before returning copied maps.
phaseSemantics.parse: Convert legacy/inlined palettes, feed fluid/dimension inputs, decode full/partial modifiers, fill images, add enabled/orphan modifiers, and add colored lights.
phaseSemantics.apply: Apply each modifier to blocks, retain returned prior properties, and install tick/sound/particle/tint behavior.
phaseSemantics.reset: Apply captured prior properties, clear modifier/ticker/tint tables, and restore captured grass/foliage resolvers.
phaseSemantics.live: Block colors/properties, random tick emitters, terrain particles, fluid/dimension conversion and light consumers are distinct edges.

questions: Captured prior values and enabled/partial inputs are not a transaction across managers. Actual tick and renderer hooks remain unqualified.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Merge own images and converted Colormatic images.
phaseSemantics.parse: Merge extra legacy inputs, parse always, fill/adopt texture roles, and add enabled or texture-only modifiers.
phaseSemantics.apply: Log installed modifier count; platform wrapper installation occurs through delegated paths.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear modifier/extra tables, clear platform-specific wrappers, and restore captured water resolver.
phaseSemantics.live: Platform fluid extension wrappers and fog/color samplers consume the resulting state.

questions: Follow platform clearSpecial/addModifier into NeoForge wrappers and confirm active readers retain the intended generation.

phaseSemantics.parse: Clear model/layer registries, decode models, register definitions, then build layers; layer construction exceptions log and continue.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear model and layer registries.
phaseSemantics.live: Model-layer registration/baking consumes generated layer definitions later.

questions: A registered model with a failed layer is a distinct partial result. Full renderer/bake consumers remain open.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Inherited resource collection; early model-only decoding separately requests models.
phaseSemantics.parse: Parse always, fill companion textures, and add enabled or image-only modifiers.
phaseSemantics.apply: Apply to items, capture returned prior properties, attach selected modifiers, then clear pending modifier map.
phaseSemantics.reset: Apply retained prior properties and detach item modifiers; the shown reset does not itself clear vanillaProperties.
phaseSemantics.live: Item colors/tooltips/rarity/armor/models/pose/overlay and emitted lights are different consumers.

questions: Qualify retained prior-property lifetime and repeated reload paths rather than assuming every table empties at reset.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Inherited resource collection; early model-only decoding requests non-auto models.
phaseSemantics.parse: Rebuild override lists from item-modifier contributions plus enabled standalone definitions; produce auto-model descriptors.
phaseSemantics.apply: Populate override model references using registry access.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear override and auto-model lists.
phaseSemantics.live: Actual item override selection and model bake consume these lists outside reload.

questions: Qualify transfer of itemModifiersModels, early/late enablement, generated model ownership, and coexistence with Modefite/Compat.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode enabled effects and resolve their biome targets into effectsToApply.
phaseSemantics.apply: On login/dynamic application, mutate resolved biome effects, retain before-images, and register fog-parameter consumers.
phaseSemantics.reset: Restore retained effects in the current level registry when available, then clear effect and fog tables and request dynamic application.
phaseSemantics.live: Biome registry incarnation and current level are part of restoration/lookup identity.

questions: A resource ID alone does not identify a biome object across registry/level generations. No cross-world restoration proof.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode enabled variants and build block/texture mappings.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear block mappings, quad cache, and forced-tint block set.
phaseSemantics.live: Quad transformation uses biome/region context and selected atlas sprites; cached quads can outlive the lookup operation.

questions: Qualify atlas generations, retained quad/sprite identity, world/biome context, and custom renderer paths.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Merge converted OptiFine/Colormatic and own lightmap images.
phaseSemantics.parse: Clear current selection, validate image heights, group normal/rain/thunder images, decode/default associated definitions, add enabled maps, and reject leftover JSON without images.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear map registry; current selection is reset by parse rather than this hook.
phaseSemantics.live: Dimension/weather/lightning and time-dependent light-texture consumers select and sample maps.

questions: Dimension selection, retained currentLightmap, dimensions/image widths and renderer upload are independently pending.

phaseSemantics.parse: Merge decoded and legacy modifiers, fill companion textures, and resolve enabled/orphan targets.
phaseSemantics.apply: On login/dynamic application, apply inplace effect changes and current-dimension selection.
phaseSemantics.reset: Request dynamic application and clear selected definition/color/cloud/darkening tables; helper paths own any further restoration.
phaseSemantics.live: Dimension transitions, sky/fog/weather/cloud/lightmap and sunset callbacks consume live/cached state.

questions: Track alteredVanillaEffects and current-dimension consumers through actual generation changes; reset method name is not restoration evidence.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode full/partial modifiers, attach companion color data and enabled/orphan modifiers, then decode a separately supplied XP-orb replacement.
phaseSemantics.apply: Log modifier count.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear particle modifier table; the shown hook does not clear the separate XP-orb fields.
phaseSemantics.live: Particle creation/update and XP-orb replacement have different state roots.

questions: Qualify lifetimes of existing particles and separate XP-orb state rather than deriving reset of both from one clear.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode enabled GUI definitions; resolve class/menu/title targets into modifier and slot indexes. General class names use Class.forName(String), not metadata-only lookup.
phaseSemantics.apply: Log nonempty target indexes.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear menu/class/title and slot indexes.
phaseSemantics.live: Screen/menu/slot consumers match actual class, registry ID or title; class lookup can initialize existing code before index publication.

questions: ClassNotFoundException is handled locally; initialization/linkage failures are different. No actual GUI pack or security exploit is qualified.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Reload heart-sprite metadata before returning default assets.
phaseSemantics.parse: Decode enabled modifiers and replace matching texture IDs with a warning.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear blit modifier table.
phaseSemantics.live: An active render region and incrementing blit index determine application; heart sprites and render-state boundaries are separate.

questions: Follow index scope, interception order, heart metadata, render-state restoration, and mixed GUI consumers.

phaseSemantics.parse: Register enabled entity modifiers.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear emittersPerEntity.
phaseSemantics.live: Entity tick/emitter and colored-light consumers use resolved entity-type mappings.

questions: Actual entity identity, emission timing and already-created particles are outside table clearing.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Parse creative_tabs CSV into extraTabs before returning default assets.
phaseSemantics.parse: Register CSV/declared new tabs, add enabled modifiers, and enqueue tab sorting when custom tabs exist.
phaseSemantics.apply: Invalidate cached creative-tab parameters when refresh is needed.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear preview, unregister custom tabs, enqueue logout sorting, restore captured attributes, mark old modifiers for refresh, then clear pending modifiers.
phaseSemantics.live: Creative inventory rebuild/preview and tab order consume registry entries and refresh state.

questions: Enqueued sort is not completed sorting, and unregister does not prove all open screens dropped a tab reference.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode per-target specs with logged partial results, publish a copied definition map and set dirty.
phaseSemantics.apply: Own apply hook is empty.
phaseSemantics.reset: Clear definitions and call destroyAll on existing render targets.
phaseSemantics.live: ensureAllocated creates/resizes targets later; getTarget returns references used by post chains.

questions: destroyBuffers does not establish GPU completion or retirement of references held by post chains.

phaseSemantics.parse: Close previous chains/depth state before decoding enabled effects into the effect list.
phaseSemantics.apply: Inherited empty hook; live tick/render owns later loading and application.
phaseSemantics.reset: Close active chains, clear definitions/failures, and close depth snapshot.
phaseSemantics.live: Tick admission, chain loading, depth capture, resize, processing, sampler bindings and rendering are separate operations.

questions: Failure after old-chain closure is not rollback. Target/sampler references, backend/device generation and actual GPU lifetime remain open.

phaseSemantics.prepare: Inherited collector with no constructor directory; callback registration is the principal input.
phaseSemantics.parse: Clear block/provider flags and invoke registration callbacks admitted by activation policy and colored-light availability.
phaseSemantics.apply: Close current volume and compute spread state; reset frame demand.
phaseSemantics.reset: Close volume, close palette only on logout, close both compute helpers, and reset requestedThisFrame.
phaseSemantics.live: World/block changes, renderer demand, async queues, palette and compute/storage resources have distinct custody.

questions: Callback invocation executes external code. Track shared palette lifetime, queued changes, compute submissions and device/world generations.

phaseSemantics.parse: Decode enabled per-shader expression maps into a new parsed map.
phaseSemantics.apply: Publish parsed map as uniformsByShader.
phaseSemantics.reset: Replace both maps with empty maps.
phaseSemantics.live: Expression evaluation and actual shader binding occur later under rendering context.

questions: A published expression map is not an initialized shader uniform or proof of active backend compatibility.
